memory_bridge: Use the same school tower twice: its 高校（こうこう） sign supplies compound On コウ, while looking from the ground to its roof prompts the complete adjective 高い（たかい）, high.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 高校（こうこう）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: The tall structure becomes a school tower labeled 高校（こうこう）. The repeated school compound anchors On コウ.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 高い（たかい）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: Crane your neck toward the tower’s roof and call it 高い（たかい）—high. The full adjective, not a “tall kite” splice, carries the reading.
